mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_shared_snapshot_item(exam_code, question_type, question_id, display_order) VALUES (#{examCode}, #{questionType}, #{questionId}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, exam_code as examCode, question_type as questionType, question_id as questionId, display_order as displayOrder FROM exam_shared_snapshot_item WHERE exam_code = #{examCode} ORDER BY display_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_shared_snapshot_item WHERE exam_code = #{examCode}
SELECT question_type as questionType, count(*) as questionCount FROM exam_shared_snapshot_item WHERE exam_code = #{examCode} GROUP BY question_type
